HomePage.featureCard2Text: Onani zambiri za mbiri zapoyera zomwe zilipo, kuphatikizapo mbiri yaifupi, otsatira, amene akutsatira, mapositi, ndi zizindikiro zovomerezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito InstaView Stories ngati Chowonera Mbiri za Instagram chosavuta kuti mufufuze maakaunti apoyera pa malo amodzi.

HomePage.featureCard5Text: Sungani zithunzi ndi mavidiyo a Nkhani za Instagram zapoyera zomwe zilipo pamene njira yotsitsira ikugwira ntchito. Chotsitsira Nkhani za Instagram chimapereka njira yothandiza yofikira zinthu za Nkhani zogwirizana.
HomePage.featureCard6Text: Tsitsani Nkhani Zosungidwa za Instagram zapoyera zomwe zilipo pamene zikugwira ntchito. Gwiritsani ntchito Chotsitsira Nkhani Zosungidwa za Instagram kuti musunge zithunzi ndi mavidiyo a Zosungidwa zogwirizana kuti muwonenso pambuyo pake.
HomePage.featureCard7Text: Onani ndi kusunga zithunzi zomwe zilipo kuchokera ku mapositi apoyera a Instagram. Chotsitsira Zithunzi za Instagram chathu chimapereka njira yosavuta yotsitsira zithunzi zapoyera zogwirizana.
HomePage.featureCard8Text: Fikirani mavidiyo omwe alipo kuchokera ku mapositi ndi mbiri zapoyera za Instagram. Tsitsani mavidiyo apoyera a Instagram ogwirizana pogwiritsa ntchito njira yosavuta komanso yothandiza.
HomePage.featureCard9Text: Fufuzani ndi kutsitsa Reels zapoyera za Instagram zomwe zilipo pamene zikugwira ntchito. Chotsitsira Reels za Instagram chimapangitsa kuti pakhale posavuta kufikira mavidiyo a Reel ogwirizana kuchokera ku mbiri zapoyera kapena malinki a mapositi mwachindunji.
